theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_vdb_liminf_ratio_bound_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (r : ℝ), ⨆ i, ν i (thickening r W) ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ W → ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → liminf (fun i ↦ ν i (closedBall x ρ)) atTop ≤ (c : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (closedBall x ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
